topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I can't help but think about all the little things, you know? When I heard that my kid would have the same teacher I had, my mind just started racing. I mean, it’s Ms. Thompson. She was always so strict, the kind who makes you sweat over every detail, and I remember how nervous I used to get. I’m trying to be cool, telling myself it’s going to be fine, but I can’t shake the feeling that it's all coming back. I hope I can help my kid navigate this, or at least not pass on my old jitters. I guess we’ll just have to take it one day at a time and hope it all turns out better than I remember.
